nodeData.topic: Day 01 · A Sweet Secret: Krishna as Goddess Gauri
nodeData.note: · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. Maharaj tells the Gauri-tirtha pastime from Srila Rupa Goswami's Vidagdha-madhava: to stop Abhimanyu taking Radharani to Mathura, Krishna disguises himself as the goddess Gauri at Govardhana and turns Jatila's suspicion into a reason for Radharani to stay in Vraja. Along the way he speaks on believing rumours and serving for Krishna's full pleasure, and in the questions explains why pure devotees faint and why material eyes cannot see Krishna. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

children.note:
Maharaj opens with a pastime Srila Rupa Goswami describes in his play Vidagdha-madhava. It takes place at Gauri-tirtha, at the foot of Govardhana Hill near the village of Aanyor, a little inside the parikrama path opposite Sankarshan Kund.

🎙 Maharaj at 09:59 (auto-transcript): “Sri Upa Goswami described in all of his books the doctor madhava the past and krishna and his confidential associates performed and this particular place called gori tita gori tita is at the base of golden hill within the”

children.topic: Q1 · Why do pure devotees faint?
children.note:
Of all the ecstatic symptoms, why is fainting the most common among pure devotees?

🎙 Question from the floor at 39:56 (auto-transcript): “We see that an ecstatic symptom exhibited by Piyodivortis is fainting. Hmm, ecstatic symptoms of Piyodivortis is usually fainting. Yes, why is it fainting the most common? So why fainting? Even those who are materially addicted, even those who are materially addicted, after…”

orbit.ref: A Sweet Secret: Krishna as Goddess Gauri | Vidagdha Madhava | Mayapur, India | Feb 08, 2025 · 39:56

children.note:
When one truly sees Krishna, not a picture or a form we only look at, the fragrance of his body welcomes the devotee and he falls unconscious. Maharaj gives the example of Gopa-kumara fainting in the Yamuna and returning to consciousness only after some days. The last layers of material consciousness are erased that way. — “pure devotees always have this experience falling unconscious”

🎙 Maharaj at 41:02 (auto-transcript): “so he mentioned that the first when one see krishna when one see krishna not not the not the deity from we see not the picture will see when one really see christina the the fragrance from christian's body will be it would this that world welcomes you one who sees christian…”

orbit.ref: A Sweet Secret: Krishna as Goddess Gauri | Vidagdha Madhava | Mayapur, India | Feb 08, 2025 · 41:02

children.note:

🎙 Maharaj at 42:56 (auto-transcript): “so we entered through that channel and then other things come in laughing uncontrollably palpitation or population they are for dancing and rolling on the ground being on on consign about public opinion whether they like it and whatever they think about you doesn't have any…”

children.topic: Q2 · Can material eyes see Krishna?
children.note:
Can we see Krishna with our material eyes while living in this world?

🎙 Question from the floor at 44:13 (auto-transcript): “maharaj my question was can we see krishna through our material eyes also while staying in this material world can we can experience krishna that is Can we see also Maharaj? Material cannot enter. Material eyes cannot see Krishna. Krishna doesn't have a material body. How can…”

orbit.ref: A Sweet Secret: Krishna as Goddess Gauri | Vidagdha Madhava | Mayapur, India | Feb 08, 2025 · 44:13

children.note:
No. Krishna has no material body, so material eyes cannot see him. Maharaj also cites the Bible's saying that the eyes that see God shall die: the material vision must end. — “Material cannot enter. Material eyes cannot see Krishna.”

🎙 Maharaj at 44:31 (auto-transcript): “Material cannot enter. Material eyes cannot see Krishna. Krishna doesn't have a material body. How can we see Krishna with material eyes? We need the spiritual eyes to see Krishna. Even in the Bible it is said, the eyes that see God shall die. It means that the material…”

orbit.ref: A Sweet Secret: Krishna as Goddess Gauri | Vidagdha Madhava | Mayapur, India | Feb 08, 2025 · 44:31

children.note:
We do not need a new body, but we must purify our senses: the eyes to see Krishna, the tongue to chant the pure name, the ears to hear pure narrations. Now we are in the process of hearing.

🎙 Maharaj at 45:05 (auto-transcript): “So, we need the spiritual eye to see, to see Krishna. Having a spiritual eye doesn't necessarily mean that we have to change the body together. We can purify the eye to see. Just like we can purify our tongue to change pure name. We can purify our ears to hear pure narrations…”

orbit.ref: A Sweet Secret: Krishna as Goddess Gauri | Vidagdha Madhava | Mayapur, India | Feb 08, 2025 · 45:05

children.note:
When Lord Nityananda first came to Navadvipa and met Caitanya Mahaprabhu, both fell unconscious. Mahaprabhu had Srivasa Pandit recite a Bhagavatam verse to bring Nityananda back. Maharaj contrasts this with Garuda trying to wake Hanuman by hand and being kicked away: chanting is the process.
